title: Orchestrate Agentic Workflows with North Automations | Cohere
gist: Cohere launched North Automations, an agent-orchestration layer on top of its North platform that lets enterprises chain per-step model routing, governance controls, and cross-system integrations into auditable workflows, targeting what it frames as a $550B agent-orchestration market opportunity.

insights.claim: Cohere frames agent orchestration as a $550B market opportunity, positioning it as the missing centralized coordination layer needed to close the gap between enterprises' AI agent potential and actual ROI.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: A vendor-stated TAM figure for the emerging agent-orchestration category, useful as a benchmark against rival platform claims (e.g. Microsoft, Salesforce, UiPath) when sizing the space.
insights.locator: This $550B market opportunity addresses the core ROI challenges

insights.claim: Gartner analysts Anushree Verma and Alastair Woolcock state in the Agentic AI Hype Cycle 2026 report that current enterprise AI agent deployments are mostly individual, task-specific agents that deliver only incremental benefits and create a value gap versus enterprise-scale adoption.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Independent analyst validation that single-purpose agent deployments are hitting diminishing returns, which supports the investment thesis behind orchestration platforms broadly, not just Cohere's.
insights.quote: Current AI agent implementations are mostly built with individual, task-specific agents that provide incremental benefits, but create a value gap for enterprise-scale AI adoption,
insights.locator: notes Gartner research analysts Anushree Verma and Alastair Woolcock

insights.claim: Cohere identifies three structural failure modes in current enterprise agent rollouts: narrow single-task agents that don't mirror how employees actually work across systems, fragmented implementation that blocks governance at scale, and using the same model for every workflow step, which inflates budgets versus routing the cheapest sufficient model per step.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Functions as a de facto buying checklist enterprises can use to evaluate any agent-orchestration vendor, not just Cohere.

insights.claim: North Automations lets users assign a different LLM to each individual step of a workflow, explicitly to balance cost against performance rather than running one model across an entire pipeline.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Per-step model routing as a built-in cost lever signals where orchestration vendors expect to compete on unit economics versus pure-play single-model agent tools.
insights.locator: Choose the appropriate model at each step of the process to balance cost with performance

insights.claim: North Automations applies software-style release discipline to agentic workflows: a 'Plan mode' to review and edit the approach before building, versioning to track changes over time, and staged testing before publishing to production.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: CI/CD-style controls for agent workflows are becoming a baseline enterprise requirement, differentiating platform vendors from lightweight single-agent builders.
insights.locator: Use Plan mode to review and edit your approach before building

insights.claim: North Automations' governance layer lets admins designate approval checkpoints where colleagues must sign off, track which users are most active, and monitor input/output token consumption to manage costs.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Built-in audit and approval trails are positioned as a prerequisite for scaling agents past pilot stage, a feature gap that likely drives enterprise churn away from point-solution agent tools lacking it.
insights.locator: Identify the key moments to loop in colleagues for approval

insights.claim: The underlying North platform supports deployment in any on-prem or cloud environment and is model-agnostic, letting customers use Cohere's own generative/search models or any external LLM, plus first-party integrations, custom MCP tools, or Cohere's SDK to build bespoke agentic platforms.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: A model-agnostic, deployment-flexible architecture reduces vendor lock-in and positions Cohere as agentic infrastructure rather than a single-model bet, relevant when comparing its strategy to closed-stack competitors.
insights.locator: Flexibly choose from Cohere's highly efficient enterprise-specific generative or search models, or any external LLM

insights.claim: Cohere's own Marketing Operations team built an automation connected to its BigQuery data semantic layer that translates plain-language questions into SQL, runs the analysis, and returns answers instantly, removing an analyst bottleneck.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: A concrete production example of natural-language-to-SQL agent workflows, a use case that competes directly with BI/analytics copilots from Snowflake, ThoughtSpot, and Databricks.
insights.quote: North translates plain-language questions into SQL, runs the analysis, and returns the answer instantly, removing analysis bottleneck, accelerating speed to insights, and liberating analysts to pursue more strategic endeavors.
insights.locator: Our Marketing Operations team created an automation to streamline

insights.claim: Cohere's Customer Success leadership automated a daily 1:1 prep workflow that cross-references HR system rosters against meeting schedules, then pulls activity summaries from Slack, Salesforce and other sources into a morning Slack digest for managers.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Demonstrates multi-system agent orchestration (HR + calendar + chat + CRM) as a template for people-ops automation, a workflow pattern relevant to HR-tech and people-analytics vendors.
insights.quote: This level of detail wouldn't be possible without North Automations.
insights.locator: Our Customer Success leadership team built a daily customer engagement tracker

insights.claim: Cohere's Sales team built an automation that aggregates Salesforce opportunity data, Slack and Gmail conversations, Notion notes, and external market research into a single prep presentation ahead of prospect calls.
insights.speaker: Cohere
insights.so_what: Shows agent orchestration collapsing multi-tool sales prep into a single output, a use case that overlaps with sales-enablement AI vendors like Gong and Clari.
insights.quote: we have upleveled our prep and discovery process to focus on deeply understanding and building strong relationships with the customer.
insights.locator: Our Sales team built an automation to more effectively and efficiently prepare for prospect calls
